meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Webex 适配器代码复制进你的项目、注册成可用频道，并安装指定版本的依赖包。它会引导你创建 Webex 机器人、设置回调地址，把令牌和密钥写入配置，让 NanoClaw 能通过 Webex 收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加或接入 Webex 频道，或正在 /setup 流程中需要配置渠道时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Webex 频道
say.note: Claude 会开始复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 接入 Webex，我还没有机器人
say.note: Claude 会先完成代码部分，再提醒你去创建 bot。

say.text: 在 /setup 里把 Webex 也配好
say.note: 接着设置流程，把 Webex 接到代理组。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Webex adapter into your project, registers it, and installs the pinned dependency. It then prompts you to create a Webex bot and set a webhook, storing the credentials so NanoClaw can chat over Webex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or integrate a Webex channel for NanoClaw, or when you're in the /setup flow and need to configure it.

say_en.note: Claude starts copying the adapter and installing dependencies.

say_en.text: Integrate Webex; I don't have a bot yet
say_en.note: Claude does the code first, then prompts you to create the bot.
Continues the setup flow, wiring Webex to an agent group.
